description: Agent Handoffs: submit a handoff format: each field it carries with the part of the context it holds (the goal, the current state, the decisions already made, the limits the task runs under or the open questions) and whether the format refuses a handoff without it, plus how the receiving agent fills each part the format leaves out (asks the sender, reads a shared record, reconstructs it from history or assumes it). The signed report says part by part what travels with the task and what the receiver is left to reconstruct or assume, and names every part the format leaves out that the receiver assumes or has no source for, every part it reconstructs from history or must ask the sender for after the handoff, and every part carried only in an optional field, with the fix for each. This reads the format every handoff uses, not one job’s state: one job’s state assembled into a resume pack is wever_job-handoff-pack, the records of handoffs made are wever_handoff-record-check and whether sharing context with a recipient needs consent is wever_context-sharing-check. Verdict receiver_guesses, transfer_gaps, transfer_unverified or context_travels. POST /api/context-transfer-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.

carries.description: The part of the context it carries: the goal, the current state, the decisions already made, the limits the task runs under, the open questions or something else.

required.description: The format refuses a handoff without this field.

format.description: The handoff format, such as the task envelope the planner sends.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

receiver_fills.description: How the receiving agent fills each part the format leaves out.

how.description: How the receiver gets it when the format does not carry it: asks the sender, reads a shared record, reconstructs it from history or assumes it.

name: wever_context-transfer-check
title: Context transfer check
